messages:
Maya: FYI - OmniHealth POC asking for a Dedicated GPU pool for a PHI-handling trial. They want 4x H100 GPUs in europe-west1, single-tenant pool, VPC peering + customer KMS, and sample pricing. Target provisioning window: next Mon (they're pushing). Can we do this and what's the rough ETA? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Raf: @Maya we can support. Quick q: do they require the 4 GPUs on a single host (NVLink) or up to 4 separate nodes is fine? Also, expected workload (throughput / seq len)?

Maya: @Raf they prefer contiguous for latency but can accept separate nodes if necessary. Expect ~80 tokens/sec per GPU, typical seq len ~1024, model ~70B dense-ish. No training, inference-only.

Leo: @Maya heads-up on infra side: we currently have limited H100 reserved capacity in eu-west1. We can provision 4x H100 but it requires a short quota/reservation flow with the cloud partner. Need VPC peering CIDR, peering account/project id, and billing approval. If CSM provides those today I can start the reservation. ETA: ~72 hours after we have all details.

Anita: Security note: KMS is ok but we need the customer KMS key ARN + assurance of key policy allowing Redwood to encrypt/decrypt (or an agreed key-wrapping flow). Also need confirmation on data residency controls and whether logs can be forwarded to their SIEM. We'll need to complete the short security checklist before handing over access.

Devon: For pricing: Dedicated = monthly pool base + per-GPU-hour usage. For a short POC we can offer a 2-week trial credit (ask finance). If they want burst fallback to hosted, that's supported via routing policies; cost will be hosted rates for spilled requests. I can DM the POC pricing sheet.

Maya: They also asked about SLAs and failover: can we automatically fall back to hosted models if pool is saturated?

Devon: Yes — we can set a routing policy: prefer dedicated, fallback to hosted (same API surface). No code changes required from customer side. We'll surface expected latency/cost delta in the doc.

Raf: I'll prep a short eval harness and an env-check checklist for the CSM to run. Will include a smoke test to validate peering, KMS, and inference latency.

Leo: To speed provisioning, please have CSM fill this minimal provisioning snippet and attach:

```
pool_request:
  customer_name: "OmniHealth"
  pool_size_gpus: 4
  gpu_sku: "H100"
  region: "europe-west1"
  contiguous: true  # true if they want NVLink topology
  vpc_peering_cidr: "10.240.0.0/21"
  peering_project_id: "projects/redwood-peer-omni"
  billing_contact: "finance@omnihealth.com"
  kms_key_arn: "arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-..."
```

Leo: Also need the CSM to confirm whether they require private egress or NAT gateway. If private-only, we'll need a transit VPC setup which adds ~1 business day.

deploy-bot: provisioning-ticket #8472 created by leo: "eu-west1 H100 reservation request for OmniHealth"

Maya: I'll ask CSM to get the CIDR, KMS ARN, and billing OK. @Anita is there any additional artifact we should request from the customer to unblock SOC/compliance?

Anita: Please request: SOC2 report (if available), KMS key policy snippet, and the Data Flow diagram (simple). Also ask whether PII/PHI will be stored or just processed in-memory. If PHI stored, we escalate to enterprise security for a quick review.

Maya: Got it. I'll push this to the CSM now and update Omni. Thanks all — I'll ping when I have the form back. :thumbsup:
